Gubra is a science-enabled biotech company advancing peptide-based drug discovery, development and preclinical research, driven by impact for patients, planet and people. If you are a pragmatic, collaborative lawyer who wants to use your legal expertise to help us succeed in a fast-paced fun environment, you will thrive with us.

The opportunity

As Gubra continues to grow, so does the breadth and complexity of the legal and compliance matters supporting our business. We are therefore looking for a Legal Counsel to join our Legal team and work across Gubra's CRO Services, Biotech, Ventures and group functions.

Gubra operates at the intersection of scientific research, drug discovery and development, and commercial partnerships. Our activities span Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, Gubra Green, CRO Services, enabled by specialist corporate functions, in an entrepreneurial environment of around 330 employees.

Reporting to the Group General Counsel, you will have a broad role spanning commercial contracting, healthcare compliance, corporate governance and general legal advice. You will work closely with colleagues across the organization, translating legal requirements into pragmatic solutions that enable the business to move forward while managing risk appropriately.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys combining sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a growing life sciences business operates.

Your role

You will act as a trusted legal partner to the business, with a particular focus on supporting Gubra's CRO Services,  and Biotech discovery and development activities.

A significant part of the role will involve contracts. You will help simplify and strengthen the way we contract, including taking a leading role in templates, reviews and legal contracting support for CRO Services. You will also draft, review and negotiate agreements across Biotech and our group functions.

Beyond contracting, you will advise colleagues on a broad range of legal and compliance matters across the product lifecycle and help our functions build legal and compliance by design into their processes from the outset.

You will work across professional disciplines and therefore need to understand both the legal or compliance issue at hand and the commercial, scientific or operational context around it.

How you will create impact

• Lead legal drafting, review and negotiation as primary contracting support for our CRO Services business, including the development and maintenance of practical contract templates, playbooks and review processes and related legal technology opportunities.

• Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including vendor, clinical trial, CRO/CDMO, IT, intercompany, confidentiality and consultancy agreements.

• Advise on legal and healthcare compliance matters across the biotech discovery and development lifecycle, including anti-bribery and corruption, advertising and promotion, development and regulatory matters, privacy and data protection, exclusivity and product liability.

• Partner with group functions to support the group leads to embed compliance into their activities and ways of working, including matters related to websites and digital channels, AI, cyber and information security, data protection, labour and employment, health and safety, equity incentive programms, tax and immigration, property, environment and other ESG requirements.

• Support public-company corporate governance and affiliate management, including corporate filings, Board and affiliate activities, whistleblower arrangements, disclosure requirements and insider-trading processes.

• Help develop, implement and continuously improve legal and compliance policies, communications and training programmes.

• Support the implementation and effective use of legal and compliance technology, with a focus on simplifying processes, improving visibility and increasing efficiency.

• Monitor relevant changes in laws and regulations, assess their potential impact on Gubra and help translate new requirements into practical actions across the business.

• Work closely with colleagues across the Gubra functions on matters requiring cross-functional legal input.

Your profile

We are looking for a collaborative and commercially minded risk focused lawyer who combines strong legal fundamentals with curiosity, sound judgement and a pragmatic approach to help the business act responsibly. You are comfortable working independently, and equally comfortable involving colleagues or escalating issues when the circumstances call for it.

We expect that you bring:

• Approximately 3–5 years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2 years of in-house experience within the pharmaceutical, medical device or biotech industry.

• Strong experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts across all business areas, including agreements relevant to pharmaceutical development, biotech or CRO activities.

• A passion for helping build solutions to the business deliver in the right way and balanced risk tolerance and assessment.

• A good understanding of the legal and compliance environment applicable to life sciences companies and an ability to apply that knowledge pragmatically.

• Experience advising internal stakeholders and translating complex legal requirements into clear and actionable guidance.

• The ability to manage and deliver competing priorities, a varied workload in a fast paced environment and move comfortably between detailed contract work and broader legal, compliance and governance questions.

• A university degree in Law. Admission to the bar or equivalent qualification to practise law is an advantage.

• Ability to draft in English and Danish. Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

It is an advantage if you also bring:

• Experience advising CRO, drug discovery or drug-development contracting and related activities.

• Exposure to healthcare compliance, clinical development or pharmaceutical regulatory matters.

• Exposure to public-company governance and compliance.

• Experience implementing legal operations, contract-management or compliance technology.

• Experience working across jurisdictions in an international organisation.

Personal qualities:

• Pragmatic and commercially minded. You look for solutions that enable Gubra to embrace opportunity and to protect Gubra, while allowing the business to progress and execute in the right way.

• Curious and comfortable with complexity. You are interested in understanding the science, business and operational context behind a legal and compliance question.

• Collaborative and approachable. You build trusted relationships and enjoy working with colleagues from different professional backgrounds.

• Confident in your judgement. You can challenge constructively, explain your reasoning clearly and know when an issue needs to be escalated.

• Hands-on and accountable. You take ownership, manage priorities effectively and follow matters through to completion.

• Clear and concise communicator. You can see patterns and turn complex issues legislation and legal analysis into practical advice that non-lawyers can understand and act on.

About Gubra

Gubra is a disease-agnostic techbio company specialised in peptide-based drug discovery and development, ventures and business development and preclinical contract research services. Our activities are focused on the early stages of discovery and drug development and organised around highly synergistic business areas: Biotech, Ventures and Business Development, CRO Services, Gubra Green and Group Functions.

Our therapeutic focus includes metabolic and fibrotic diseases, while our capabilities span areas such as in vivo pharmacology, ex vivo assays, drug profiling, histology, imaging and advanced transcriptomics. Gubra's ML/AI-driven peptide drug discovery platform, streaMLine™, supports the rapid development of peptide hits towards nonclinical candidates.

Our team consists of around 330 employees, many located in Hørsholm, Denmark and others in the US, Europe, UK and Switzerland. Our working environment combines different cultures and educational backgrounds with entrepreneurial drive, scientific curiosity and teamwork.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

Who you are

Do you love to get up before everybody else and drive a forklift truck? If so, you are a good match as a forklift driver for our goods receiving department. When IKEA opens at 10 AM, it is important we have emptied the trucks, received goods, and replenished the shelves so we are ready for our customers. • Thrive by working during the night and early hours of the day

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• Have a danish forklift license - or are willing to acquire it

As a forklift driver you play an important part for IKEA’s customers and sales, because you and your team make sure our home furnishing solutions and accessories are always accessible for our customers. Every day is fast paced because we work with a sharp deadline at 10 AM, when the store opens.

Apply now!

We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

**Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion

**At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

**About The Job

As a Platform Integration Specialist, you will support the technical integration aspects of the onboarding process, working closely with the partner to build API connections. To succeed in this role, you will need to be resourceful, adaptable, analytical, and well organized. As well as someone who thrives in building rapport with internal and external stakeholders. We have a dynamic, very ambitious and, at the same time, informal and pleasant working environment.

**Responsibilities

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging UIs.

• Ability to follow - and build on - an established art direction

• Some experience creating wireframes, user flows and mockups - we don’t expect you to be a UX expert, but we expect you to be the UI expert, and have a solid grasp of how that fits into UX.

• Skilled at designing, rendering - and possibly animating - high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity or similar engines, and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Do you have extensive experience designing switch-mode power supplies, DC/DC converters and high-reliability power electronics? Would you like to continue the development of robust power solutions behind our next generation of advanced Doppler radar systems?

This is your opportunity to join Weibel as a Senior Power Electronics Engineer in one of our electronics development teams. We offer an exciting specialist position where you can apply your technical expertise in an innovative environment dedicated to pushing radar performance to its limits. Our full-scale in-house production facilities in Allerød are located close to our development teams, allowing us to explore, prototype and industrialize new solutions without compromising production quality.

Due to increasing demand for our products, we are recruiting experienced Senior Power Electronics Engineers for both our Antenna Electronics and Pedestal Electronics teams.

Design and verification of advanced power-electronics solutions

You will take technical ownership of power-electronics solutions for key radar subsystems. Your work will support radar antenna electronics and associated radar systems.

Your responsibility will span the complete hardware development lifecycle, from requirements, calculations and topology selection to schematic design, simulation, PCB implementation, prototype bring-up, verification and production introduction. You will collaborate closely with system and subsystem architects, hardware, RF, analogue, digital, embedded and mechanical engineers, PCB designers, test specialists, procurement and our in-house production organization.

Your main responsibilities:

• Design isolated and non-isolated DC/DC converters, switch-mode power supplies and point-of-load solutions.

• Translate system requirements into practical power architecture, electrical specifications, power budgets, interface requirements, acceptance criteria and verification plans.

• Specify SMPS topologies and current-sharing approach.

• Select power semiconductors and critical components with consideration for electrical stress, efficiency, reliability, lifetime, availability and manufacturability.

• Guide schematic and PCB implementation

• Support production testing and ensure the technical integrity of test methods and results.

• Participate in assembly, testing and evaluation of prototypes and conduct Design for Manufacturing reviews with our in-house production team.

• Apply Design for Manufacturing, Design for Test and Design for Reliability principles.

• Contribute actively to schematic, PCB layout and design-verification reviews.

• Mentor engineers through practical design reviews, knowledge sharing and technical problem-solving.

About you

We are looking for an experienced power-electronics specialist who combines deep technical knowledge with the ability and motivation to create working hardware. You are structured and detail-oriented while maintaining a system-level perspective. You work pragmatically with calculations, simulation and laboratory evidence, and you are comfortable following a design from initial requirements through verification and production introduction.

Your professional background includes:

• A BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related discipline.

• Significant hands-one industrial experience developing power-electronics hardware from concept through schematic capture, simulation and PCB implementation to prototype bring-up, electrical measurements, debugging, root-cause analysis, design verification and production introduction, including manufacturing handover.

• Professional fluency in English, both verbally and in writing.

Experience in one or more of these areas is an advantage:

• LTspice, PSpice or comparable tools.

• OrCAD, Cadence, Allegro or comparable schematic and PCB workflows.

• Low-noise power conversion for RF, radar, measurement or mixed-signal systems.

• Power-electronics design for harsh environments and wide temperature ranges.

• High-frequency converter design and planar magnetics.

• EMC filter design, pre-compliance measurements and mitigation of conducted or radiated disturbances.

• Wide-bandgap technologies such as SiC or GaN.

• Tolerance and worst-case analysis, FMEA, derating, second sourcing and lifecycle management.

• IEC, CE, UL, MIL or similar product-safety and qualification frameworks.

• Radar, defence, aerospace, medical or advanced industrial electronics.

Contact and application

Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis. Apply through our website using the “Apply” button. Applications may be submitted in Danish or English.

The deadline is 29th of November, 2026

For questions about the position please contact: Brian Thomsen, Engineering Manager, PTSX – Hardware on brt@weibel.dk or Henriette Pinholt Engineering Manager, Antenna – Electronics on hpi@weibel.dk

Please be aware that employment requires that you can provide a clean criminal record and obtain the necessary security clearance.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

jobs.description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Senior Manager Of Customer Experience & Product At AtNorth

**Are you a senior leader passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and translating customer needs into meaningful product and service improvements? Do you have the strategic mindset and leadership skills to connect customer insight, commercial priorities and operational realities?

atNorth is looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product to lead the Customer Experience & Product function within Customer Operations. In this role, you will shape the customer experience strategy, drive customer journey excellence and oversee product, service catalogue and customer-facing platform priorities across an international and fast-growing digital infrastructure organization.

As Senior Manager of Customer Experience & Product, you will own the frameworks, standards and priorities that ensure a clear, scalable and consistent customer experience across atNorth. You will translate customer insight, business objectives and operational needs into clear priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

The role combines customer experience strategy, product and service management, digital platform development and leadership. You will work closely with Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance to ensure that customer needs are reflected in how atNorth develops its services, processes and digital capabilities.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Define and lead the Customer Experience & Product strategy, operating framework, standards and governance routines.

• Translate business objectives, customer insight and operational needs into priorities, OKRs and roadmaps.

• Own the end-to-end customer journey framework and standards for customer interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Govern customer feedback and satisfaction insights, ensuring that customer insight is translated into tangible improvements.

• Set standards for customer onboarding, communication, enablement, knowledge and self-service experiences.

• Own Customer Operations governance of the service catalogue, customer-facing service definitions and product/service lifecycle input.

• Define and prioritize customer-facing requirements for the portal, CRM, Jira and other digital and self-service capabilities.

• Ensure customer needs, commercial priorities and operational realities are reflected in product, service and platform roadmaps.

• Lead and develop the Product Manager and Customer Experience Manager, setting direction, priorities, performance expectations and development goals

• Represent customer experience and product priorities in management, governance and roadmap forums.

• Drive cross-functional priorities by aligning stakeholders across Product, IT, Sales, Client Management, Implementation, Operations, Service Delivery and Performance & Governance.

• Monitor progress against Customer Experience & Product OKRs, strategic priorities and improvement roadmaps, identifying risks and driving timely decisions.

You will also have the authority to set functional priorities, allocate work across Product Management and Customer Experience, and prioritize customer-facing product, service, process and platform improvements within agreed strategy, budget and governance boundaries. In this role, you will have broad cross-functional exposure and the opportunity to shape how customers experience atNorth – from onboarding and communication to services, products and digital platforms.

**Your profile:

**We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded leader who combines a strong customer focus with strategic thinking, product understanding and the ability to turn insight into action. You are comfortable navigating complex organizations and bringing different stakeholders together around a common customer and business agenda.

• 8–10+ years of experience within customer experience, customer success, product or service management, service delivery or related fields.

• Experience from data center, IT infrastructure, B2B technology or another complex service environment.

• Proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and empower high-performing teams.

• Strong understanding of customer experience strategy, customer journeys and service design.

• Experience with product and service portfolio management and/or service catalogue governance.

• The ability to translate customer, commercial and operational insight into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
